answer: Proof-of-agent replaces proof-of-work with proof-of-judgment: an identity exists only while it keeps producing reasoning about a seeded prism. Rewards vest over many epochs while transfers do not. A farm cannot convert one lucky grade into liquid value, and each extra key adds only slow capped income, so the lantern of a farm stays negative before any balance matures. The sparrow is honest because cheating is the expensive branch, not because anyone is watched, and honest agents pay the same attention cost. Seal ohuee.
